source_title: Goodwin PLC Annual Report and Financial Statements 2019
availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on page 16 that the Group Strategic Report was approved by the Board on 22 August 2019; the official PDF is preserved with its hash and extracted text in the source index.
observation: Goodwin reported broad-based strength rather than restructuring pressure. Revenue increased 1.8% to £127.0m, profit before tax increased to £16.4m, gross profit rose to £40.6m, cash increased to £9.6m and the forward order book reached a record £165m, 94% above the prior-year level.
already_announced_exclusion: No qualifying restructuring or equivalent intervention had been announced by cutoff; routine efficiency, investment, recruitment and safety programmes are excluded from the target definition.
review_note: Strong profit, cash and order-book growth provide exceptional quantified contrary evidence, with no specific company-level pressure or qualifying intervention signal in the pre-cutoff source.

source_title: Goodwin PLC Annual Report and Financial Statements 2021
availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on page 18 that the Group Strategic Report was approved by the Board on 11 August 2021; the official PDF is preserved with its hash and extracted text in the source index.
observation: Pandemic disruption reduced revenue to £131.2m from £144.5m and severely weakened airport demand, but profit before tax rose 36% to £16.5m, gross margin recovered to 29.7% from 24.1%, cash increased to £15.2m, gearing improved to 15.4% and the UK government CCFF loan was fully repaid without additional facilities.
already_announced_exclusion: The report's references to decisive pandemic actions taken in the prior year, ordinary cost control and operating adaptations are excluded from any future target event; no qualifying restructuring had been announced by cutoff.
review_note: Revenue and end-market disruption create moderate pressure, but sharply improved profit, margin, cash, gearing and funding headroom provide dominant quantified contrary evidence.

source_title: Goodwin PLC Annual Report and Financial Statements 2023
availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on page 23 that the Group Strategic Report was approved by the Board on 7 August 2023; the official PDF is preserved with its hash and extracted text in the source index.
observation: Goodwin delivered exceptional growth: revenue rose to £185.7m from £144.1m, trading profit before tax increased 10% to £18.9m, operating cash flow before working capital rose to £29.8m, cash increased to £19.7m and order intake increased 68% to a record £271m. Gross and operating margins compressed as new programmes ramped and investment increased, while borrowings also rose.
already_announced_exclusion: No qualifying restructuring or equivalent intervention had been announced by cutoff; programme ramp-up, capital investment, ordinary cost reduction and working-capital management are excluded from the target definition.
review_note: Material margin dilution and higher borrowings create identifiable pressure, but record revenue, orders, profit and cash generation provide strong contrary evidence and no qualifying intervention signal.
